name: Tau
description: Provides a small, readable terminal coding agent from Hugging Face that doubles as a reference harness for understanding how coding agents are built.

skills.name: Terminal Coding
skills.description: Reads, edits, and runs code in a repository from an interactive terminal session.

skills.name: Model Agnostic
skills.description: Runs against hosted or local models so the same harness works with open weights.

skills.name: Library Embedding
skills.description: Embeds as a Python library so the agent loop can be reused inside other tools.
